evidence_timeline.summary: We spectroscopically classify the optical transient AT2026yqj/ZTF26abgtqqr as a TDE-He at redshift z=0.1565. In addition, we classify the long-rising nuclear transient AT 2026rey/ZTF26aaximsq as a possible TDE-featureless at z=0.087.
